policy: Dated aggregate asking-price observations for buyer planning. These are not completed sales, dealer quotes, or a live marketplace feed. No listing photos or seller content are reproduced.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; 19 marked Foreign Used. Values are the lower quartile, median, and upper quartile of those asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: Promoted placements, duplicate ads, trim, mileage, condition, and seller claims may skew this small sample. Prices and availability can change. Inspect the car and verify customs documents before paying.

corroboratingSources.method: Nine visible 2018 Corolla listings marked foreign used; excluded 2008 vehicles returned by this search page. Median of asking prices, not completed sales.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded one listing labelled 2012 whose description said 2014. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 19 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A recent search snapshot, not a live feed. Promoted placement, repeat sellers, trim, mileage, and condition affect the sample. Confirm listing availability and inspect the vehicle before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded local-used, brand-new, and a contradictory registered/foreign-used listing. Interpolated 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of 15 Foreign Used asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: A recent search snapshot, not a live feed. Petrol, diesel, trim, mileage, promoted placement, and duplicate sellers can shift these figures. Check the exact vehicle and customs papers before paying.
